title: Manual for the Implementation of Environmental, Health, and Safety Standards
shortDescription: Technical book design and vector botanical/entomological wireframe cover illustration defining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to minimize insecticide impact on human health and ecosystems.
mandateChallenge: Turn complex toxicology, PPE compliance, and environmental monitoring SOPs into a durable, highly legible reference manual for field operations.
executionCraft: Created intricate white-wireframe locust vector illustrations over botanical photography, structured long-form typographic hierarchies, and delivered with zero errata across publishing cycles.
impactMetric: Zero Errata Across Publishing Cycles · Global SOP Standard
